comparator.heading: Comparator
comparator.intro: Compare insurance products across Awesome Insurance and its competitors. Select a product type, then pick between 2 and 4 products to compare.
comparator.selectType: Pick a product type to see the products available for comparison.
comparator.noProductsForType: No products available for this type.
comparator.comparingHint: This takes 10–20 seconds while the assistant reads each product document.
comparator.maxProducts: You can compare at most {{max}} products.
comparator.staleNotice: Some source data may be out of date — verify before sharing with a customer.

brochure.title: Add a competitor brochure (optional)
brochure.help: Upload a PDF brochure from another insurer to include it in this comparison. It is read once, used only for this comparison, and deleted automatically within 48 hours.
brochure.tooLarge: This PDF is larger than 4.5 MB. Use a smaller file.
brochure.noRoom: Untick a product to make room (you can compare up to 4).
brochure.sampleLabel: No brochure to hand? Try a sample:

comparator.uploadedNotice: {{name}} comes from a brochure you uploaded. It was read automatically and has not been verified. Check the details against the brochure before relying on them.

ratings.title: Carrier financial strength
ratings.illustrativeNote: Ratings shown for competitors are illustrative demonstration data, not real figures.
ratings.brochureNote: Ratings for the uploaded brochure are as stated in it and have not been verified.

pdf.hint: A PDF to give to the customer, without the internal-use marking
pdf.heading: Product comparison
pdf.uploadedNote: {{name}} was read from a brochure supplied by your advisor and has not been verified.
pdf.customerDisclaimer: Based on product documentation as of {{date}}. This comparison is for information only. It is not a quote or an offer, and it may not show every feature or exclusion. Please check the details with each insurer before you decide.

data.heading: Data Explorer
data.intro: Browse the reference documents that ground the assistant's answers — product portfolio, company information, competitive positioning, competitor products, promotions, and application form schemas.
data.selectFile: Select a document from the list to view its contents.

pdf.note: One-page brochure to share with customers. It shows no prices.
pdf.fallback: Your browser could not show the PDF here. Use Download PDF or Open in new tab.

pricing.scaledNote: Amounts are for {{amount}} of cover and scale with the sum chosen.
pricing.factorsHelp: Each factor multiplies the base rate. Factors that do not apply to the choices made are skipped.
pricing.examplesNote: Calculated with these tables, so the assistants quote the same figures.
pricing.ofIncome: of annual income, across all active policies

transcript.expires: Expires automatically, roughly 24 to 48 hours after it was last saved ({{time}}). While a session is open it is saved about every 30 seconds.
transcript.empty: Nothing has been saved in this session yet.

voice.heading: Voice Chat
voice.selectCustomer: Select a customer to start a voice conversation.
voice.emptyConnected: Type a message below, or press Start voice chat to speak. Clear resets the conversation.
voice.hintText: The assistant responds in text only. Press Start voice chat to speak and hear responses.
voice.hintVoice: Voice chat is active — the assistant will respond with voice and text. Press Stop voice chat to type only.

consent.question: Before recording: has {{name}} agreed to this conversation being transcribed?
consent.hint: Nothing is saved or remembered, and no forms are filled, until you confirm. Answer to the assistant out loud or use the buttons.
consent.changed: The customer changed, so consent is needed again.
consent.confirmed: Consent confirmed at {{time}}. This conversation is transcribed and kept for 24 hours.
consent.declinedMessage: Consent declined. The session has ended and nothing was saved.

recommendation.loading: Analyzing coverage and looking for gaps...
recommendation.noGaps: No material coverage gaps identified — the customer is well covered for their profile.

form.sentHint: Demo only — nothing was actually sent.

pdf.requiredNote: * Required. Leave any line blank that has not been answered yet and complete it by hand.
pdf.disclaimer: Draft prepared with the Awesome Insurance advisor assistant. This is not an offer of cover. Cover starts only when Awesome Insurance issues a policy after underwriting.

notes.heading: Notes
notes.textPlaceholder: e.g. Expecting a second child in March
notes.byAssistantHint: Saved by the AI assistant at the advisor's request

cockpit.heading: Today's priorities
cockpit.summary: {{needing}} of {{total}} customers need attention, most urgent first
cockpit.empty: Nothing needs your attention right now.

rules.life_event_passed: Life event {{days}} days ago, no follow-up since: {{text}}
rules.renewal_passed: {{policy}} ({{insurer}}) passed its renewal date {{days}} days ago
rules.renewal_passed_own: {{policy}} passed its renewal date {{days}} days ago
rules.over_cap: Yearly premiums are {{percent}}% of income, above the {{cap}}% guide
rules.prospect_quiet: No Awesome policy yet and no contact for {{days}} days

meetingNote.title: Meeting note
meetingNote.loading: Drafting a note from this conversation…
meetingNote.intro: Check and edit the draft, then save it to the customer's notes. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
meetingNote.insufficient: There isn't enough in this conversation to write a note yet.
meetingNote.saved: Note saved to the customer's record.

roleplay.setupIntro: The assistant plays this customer, using what is on their record. Run the conversation as you would a real one, then end it to get coaching feedback.

focus.young: I'm too young to need it
focus.compare: I want to compare with my insurer
focus.think: I need to think about it

roleplay.privacy: Nothing from a practice session is recorded or saved, and nothing is added to the customer's record. Health details are not shared with the assistant.
roleplay.banner: Practice session: the assistant is playing {{name}}
roleplay.bannerHint: Start the microphone and the customer greets you. Say "end exercise" to stop early.
roleplay.insufficient: There wasn't enough of a conversation to give feedback. Try again and say a little more.
roleplay.coachingNote: Coaching feedback for your own practice, generated by AI. It is not a performance rating and is not saved.
